name: Manage Users
description: Ensures a user account is present, locked, or absent.

parameters.name: username
parameters.label: Username
parameters.help: Lowercase letters, numbers, underscore, and hyphen.

options.label: Present
options.help: Creates the account if it doesn't exist.

options.label: Locked
options.help: Keeps the account but prevents logging in.

options.label: Absent
options.help: Deletes the account if it exists.
